instructions: pip is a creature on a stead node. Ask it in plain words; it answers when it next works. Your words are a note in its conversation: they start no work and grant nothing.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Leave pip a note in plain words, or poll an earlier ask by its handle. The note starts no work and carries no approval; pip answers when it next works, and the answer comes back on a poll.

text.description: Plain words for the creature. They wait in its conversation as a note.

handle.description: The handle an earlier ask returned, to read the answer.

tools.name: deliveries
tools.description: The report lines pip's finished threads and chores delivered to its conversation, oldest first.

after.description: The entryId of the last delivery already read; only later ones come back.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Where pip is now: working, at the porch (waiting on its keeper), back (a delivery is in), idle, or paused.
